fileNodes.summary: Vite build configuration that sets the app base path from VITE_BASE_PATH, wires the Svelte plugin, a PWA plugin (autoUpdate service worker with a StaleWhileRevalidate navigation cache), and a rollup bundle-size visualizer while disabling manual chunks.

fileNodes.name: buffs.ts
fileNodes.summary: Central constants module exporting 140 numeric values for buff and debuff potency, duration, and scaling, sourced from the game's BuffData. Covers potions, rune-granted buffs, weapon-art-granted buffs, perk-buff factory constants, potency modifiers, and generic debuff modifiers used by the damage calculation engine.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Pure data module: 140 exported UPPER_SNAKE_CASE const declarations, zero imports and zero functions, organized into commented sections that mirror the BuffData.ts definitions.

fileNodes.name: types.ts
fileNodes.summary: Central shared type definitions and constants for the damage engine, covering races, guilds, armor, rings, runes, enchantments, weapons, monk gear, build state, proc coefficients, boosts, and weapon hit data, plus helpers for upgrade scaling and proc checks.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Heavy use of template-literal types (ScalingKey), keyof typeof lookups, and discriminated unions for game-data modeling.

fileNodes.name: Boost.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines the boost system for the damage calculator: exports BOOST_DEFS (damage/heal multiplier definitions keyed by perk) and BOOST_DEF_MAP lookup, the BoostContext/BoostDef interfaces, plus helper functions calcMinionAbsorptionPotency and calcFrenzyPct and Penance bleed constants.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Data-driven design: declarative BOOST_DEFS entries combine simple multiplierPerPerk fields with optional calcFn callbacks for complex conditional boosts.

fileNodes.name: perkAutoDebuffs.ts
fileNodes.summary: Computes the debuffs a build auto-applies from its active perks and combat conditions (Burn via Exhaust, Penance bleed, Weakening, Runic Blades, Hypnotist, HP-gated effects, and more) through getAutoDebuffs, with calcActualHpFillPct adjusting HP fill for negative protection.

fileNodes.name: BuffData.ts
fileNodes.summary: Central data registry and computation module for Voxel Blade buffs and debuffs: defines the BUFF_DEFS metadata table and BASIC_DEBUFF_POOL, and provides the logic to assemble a build's active buffs, apply perk-based potency/duration modifiers, convert buff types, compute buff effects, and format perk descriptions.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Large data-driven TypeScript module using Record<string, BuffDefinition> lookups with dynamicDescription closures and a pipeline of buff transformation helpers.

fileNodes.name: Perkbasedmg.ts
fileNodes.summary: Defines base-damage calculation helpers, HP-gate thresholds, and the PERK_DMG_DEFS registry for perk-based damage sources (springblast, bomber charge, ichor spark) used by the build damage engine.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Large data-driven TypeScript module: a lookup map of perk damage definitions plus small exported pure functions that compute base damage and gate thresholds.

fileNodes.name: utils.ts
fileNodes.summary: Provides shared math, text-highlighting, and proc-chance utility helpers used across the damage engine and UI, including multiplier rounding, scaling factors, warding debuff multipliers, search highlighting, and proc chance computation.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Mostly pure functions with a type-only import; several helpers rely on percent-to-multiplier conventions shared with the engine.

fileNodes.name: stats.html
fileNodes.summary: Self-contained Rollup Visualizer HTML report (generated build artifact) showing the Voxel Blade production bundle's size distribution as an interactive treemap, with embedded compiled rendering code and inline module-tree data.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Single-file artifact bundling a minified preact-compatible VDOM renderer with d3 hierarchy/treemap layout, plus an inline JSON tree of the rolldown output modules; SVG is produced at runtime rather than in markup.

fileNodes.name: BaseDamageCalc.svelte
fileNodes.summary: Core per-hit damage calculation component. Receives weapon hits, typed boosts, debuffs, crit values, enemy defenses, and DoT data as props, then computes final damage per hit type by applying armor penetration, damage-type multipliers, debuff effects, crits, and heal sources. Renders the computed hit breakdown with badges and tooltips.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Large Svelte 5 component (2812 lines) using legacy `export let` props; damage math lives in `$:` reactive blocks and internal helper functions.

fileNodes.name: DamageAnalyzer.svelte
fileNodes.summary: Main damage analysis screen. Assembles active buffs/debuffs from the build store, resolves weapon/weapon-art/rune/mount-damage scalings and damage-type conversions, computes DoT ticks, self-damage perks, and defensive sources, then feeds computed hits into the BaseDamageCalc engine. Renders scaling breakdowns, per-hit rows, and toggle controls for boosts, buffs, and effects.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Massive Svelte 5 component (7560 lines) with dozens of `$:` reactive derived blocks and IIFEs computing derived values.

fileNodes.name: boosts.ts
fileNodes.summary: Pure constant module exporting 64 named numeric boost multipliers used across the damage engine, covering frenzy, minion absorption, lifesteal, per-stack perk multipliers, Heat Drill, and Essence Ray tuning values.
fileNodes.languageNotes: Barrel of exported constants with no functions or classes; grouped by perk categories via comments.
